title.zh: 杜鲁门主义：致国会咨文

caption.en: The printed opening page requests assistance for Greece and Turkey, an early statement of U.S. Cold War policy.
caption.zh: 印刷首页请求援助希腊与土耳其，是美国冷战政策的早期表述。

alt.en: A printed congressional document headed Recommendation for Assistance to Greece and Turkey.
alt.zh: 印刷国会文件，标题为援助希腊与土耳其的建议。

interpretation.en: The opening text presents instability in Greece as a concern for U.S. foreign policy. The heading and request for aid show how Truman put this argument before Congress.
interpretation.zh: 开篇把希腊局势不稳表述为美国外交关切。标题与援助请求显示杜鲁门如何把这一主张提交国会。

items.creator: Harry S. Truman; United States House of Representatives

creator.zh: 哈里·S·杜鲁门；美国众议院

caption.en: Congress’s joint resolution authorized expanded U.S. military action in Southeast Asia; this copy bears the presidential approval dated August 10.
caption.zh: 国会联合决议授权扩大美国在东南亚的军事行动；此件总统批准日期为8月10日。

alt.en: A red-bordered joint resolution with congressional signatures, an approval stamp and Lyndon Johnson’s signature.
alt.zh: 红框联合决议，带国会签名、批准日期印记及林登·约翰逊签名。

interpretation.en: The resolution combines a justification for military action with a broad grant of presidential authority. Its account of attacks is the government’s claim within that argument, not independent confirmation of the incidents.
interpretation.zh: 决议把军事行动的理由与对总统的广泛授权结合起来。其中关于袭击的叙述属于政府论证中的主张，并非对事件的独立证实。

title.zh: 瓜达尔卡纳尔亨德森机场的飞机

caption.en: Marine SBD aircraft warm up before a strike at Henderson Field, showing the airfield at the center of the Guadalcanal campaign.
caption.zh: 海军陆战队SBD飞机在亨德森机场起飞出击前暖机，显示瓜岛战役的核心机场。

alt.en: Rows of propeller aircraft stand across a field, with vegetation and a covered structure in the foreground.
alt.zh: 成排螺旋桨飞机停在机场，前景有植被与覆盖的设施。

interpretation.en: Rows of aircraft and canvas structures show the airfield’s wartime activity. This official Marine Corps photograph records the military use of Henderson Field during the island campaign.
interpretation.zh: 成排飞机与帆布设施呈现机场的战时活动。这张海军陆战队官方照片记录瓜岛战役期间亨德森机场的军事使用。

note.en: NARA identifies this as Marine Corps photograph 127-GR-14-88-108572, dated 10 December 1942, in RG 127. Its official military-series identity establishes federal production; the image URL is the NARA article’s published WordPress CDN rendition.
note.zh: 国家档案馆确认此件为1942年12月10日海军陆战队照片127-GR-14-88-108572，属RG 127。官方军事系列身份说明联邦制作来源；图像地址是该馆文章发布的WordPress分发版本。

title.zh: 获释美国战俘离开河内

caption.en: Released American prisoners celebrate aboard an aircraft leaving Hanoi during the prisoner-return arrangements following the Paris agreement.
caption.zh: 巴黎协议之后战俘遣返安排实施期间，获释美国战俘在离开河内的飞机上庆祝。

alt.en: Men seated closely inside a transport aircraft smile and lift their hands and fists.
alt.zh: 运输机内紧密就座的男子微笑并举起手臂和拳头。

interpretation.en: Prisoner repatriation followed the 27 January agreement; this flight left Hanoi on 12 February. The celebration records that return, while fighting elsewhere in Vietnam continued.
interpretation.zh: 战俘遣返在1月27日协议之后展开，这架飞机于2月12日离开河内。庆祝场景记录获释返程之际，而越南其他地区的战斗仍在继续。

note.en: NARA’s official exhibit identifies the dated photograph as Records of the United States Marine Corps and links item 532510. This official military photograph is a federal work, rather than an image accepted merely because NARA holds it.
note.zh: 国家档案馆官方展览注明照片日期及美国海军陆战队档案来源，并链接条目532510。该官方军事照片属联邦作品，而非仅凭馆藏身份获得使用依据。

title.en: Medical treatment during the battle for Huế
title.zh: 顺化战斗期间的医疗救护

caption.en: Navy Hospital Corpsman D. R. Howe treats Private First Class D. A. Crum of H Company, 2nd Battalion, 5th Marines during Operation Hue City.
caption.zh: 顺化行动期间，海军医务兵D. R. 豪为海军陆战队第5团第2营H连一等兵D. A. 克拉姆治疗。

alt.en: A seated man with a bandaged torso receives treatment from a helmeted serviceman while other armed men sit nearby.
alt.zh: 躯干缠着绷带的男子坐着接受戴头盔军人的治疗，其他持械男子坐在附近。

interpretation.en: A bandaged serviceman receives treatment beside armed members of his unit. The close view records battlefield medical care during the fighting in Huế.
interpretation.zh: 缠着绷带的军人在持械战友身旁接受治疗。近距离画面记录顺化战斗期间的战地救护。

note.en: NARA’s official exhibit identifies this dated and individually captioned service photograph as Records of the United States Marine Corps and links item 532484. Federal military authorship supports public-domain status.
